headline: Nvidia nears massive revenue milestone
standfirst: The chip giant is on track to hit $108 billion in quarterly revenue soon.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Nvidia predicts it will generate $108 billion in revenue within the next few months.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The company just reported a record $96.2 billion in revenue in its latest earnings update.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Only tech giants like Apple, Amazon, and Alphabet have hit this $100 billion quarterly mark.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for the next earnings report to see if Nvidia officially crosses this historic threshold.

caption:
Nvidia is projected to reach 108 billion dollars in revenue in the coming months.

This massive growth puts the chip maker in rare company alongside tech titans like Apple and Amazon. The milestone follows a record-breaking earnings report of 96.2 billion dollars. It signals a huge shift in the industry's financial landscape.
